title: Sequences
info: A sequence is steps in order. If the order changes, the result can change.
Recipes and computer programs both use sequences.

questions.q: When you get dressed, which should you put on first?
Step 1: draw a circle. Step 2: color it. If you skip step 1
options: there is no circle to color
you still have a colored circle
